title: Business seal
summary: A sheet with the facts behind a company's seal: legal name, trade name, CNPJ, when Bipe checked it with the Receita Federal, and until when the seal is valid. It says what the seal does not promise (ADR 0042).

state.description: verified: a valid cnpj badge bound to the account's master key. revoked: GET /v1/badges answered 410 (BadgeGone). suspended: the account had a seal and its badge no longer verifies (for example after a master key reset).

legalName.description: verified only: BadgePayload.company legal name, under bipe_badge_company_legal_name.

tradeName.description: verified only: the trade name, under bipe_badge_company_trade_name. Absent when the company has none.

cnpj.description: verified only: BadgePayload.cnpj, shown with formatCnpj (12.ABC.345/01DE-35).

checkedAt.description: verified only: the month of the registry import, under bipe_badge_company_checked.

goneReason.description: revoked only: BadgeGone.reason. notActive and notFound: bipe_badge_company_revoked_not_active. revoked and staff: bipe_badge_company_revoked.

notes: Opens from the seal next to the name in person-profile, the chat header and the chat list. The seal itself (an icon with bipe_badge_company as its label) shows only in state verified. revoked and suspended show their notice once where a seal was seen before; never a seal.

Verification on the device (security rule 2): the envelope from GET /v1/badges/{userId} (or PublicProfile.badge), the signing keys of registries/badge-keys.json, level cnpj, sub equal to the user ID, binding to the account's cross-signing master key, and exp in the future. The HTTP status alone never shows a seal. Failure of any step: no seal (fail closed). Reference: docs/badge-attestation.md. Bipe logic: BadgeVerifier, BadgeEnvelope, BadgePayload (BipeKit BadgeVerifier.swift); BipeCompanySeals, BipeCompanySealState, BipeCNPJ.formatted (BipeKit BipeCompanySeals.swift); BipeCompanySeals.kt (libraries/bipe company).
SDK gap, as in person-profile: matrix-sdk-ffi does not export UserIdentity.masterKey (pub(crate), 22 Oct 2026). The build lane needs it exported upstream or reads it from the Matrix keys query.
bipe_badge_company_body is the honest limit of the seal: Bipe checked the CNPJ and the account; it does not vouch for each offer or charge (linguagem.md section 3).
The avatar shape (rounded square for a company) comes from the account type, not from the seal (ADR 0132). An unverified company still has the square and no seal.
The CNPJ is formatted with formatCnpj in tools/lib/registries.mjs (alphanumeric CNPJ).
